_source: CUSTOMER_STORIES.md, condensed. Every id below appears in a file under live/.

stories.title: The agent that said “verified”
stories.who: A leadership-demo user (user_id leadership-demo) asking the consume agent.
stories.failure: The shipped okf aspect displays runtime, computation, executor, attester; LookupContext does not render those fields at all; neither carries a verdict. A tool contract with ok: true and no verdict field let the agent say “verified”.
stories.changes: In session f21ee192 the runtime tool returned verdict UNVERIFIABLE with a reason and receipt_id, and the agent said “No. The number is unproven.” twelve times out of twelve.
stories.status: illustration, not a controlled comparison (prompt, tool set and questions all differ)

stories.title: Twelve questions, one frozen context pack
stories.who: The same finance user, in a multi-turn session.
stories.failure: Catalog has one mutable state per entry. “Which publication was current last quarter” is not a question it can hold; parameters[] is not server-side searchable; nothing executes.
stories.changes: deployment_heads_history answers which publication was current at T (the query runs today and is empty until a sync commits). The declared parameter_schema (region, quarter_start, quarter_end) is on record as the contract an executor would bind.
stories.status: history selection real-but-empty; the numbers for questions 4 and 10 are RFC text only

stories.title: One handle, three publications, and the legacy Catalog entry names the oldest
stories.who: Whoever audits the demo after the fact.
stories.session: 04fa3d56 · 1e6dfed7 · f21ee192 (all four sessions), the adapter tape, the legacy entry
stories.failure: Catalog cannot say which publication an agent read, whether two agents read the same one, or whether an entry is stale relative to what is served.
stories.changes: Events match the context_ref_resolution view on both keys, publications join by id only, receipt-only rows are banded, adapter-tape and legacy-Catalog evidence sit in demo_evidence. The live result: 14 attributed, 13 receipt-only, no row twice despite the double-bound legacy handle.
stories.status: real after seeding (operator, not yet okf-setup)

stories.title: The metric that died on 2026-06-20
stories.who: The finance user asking questions 6 and 12.
stories.failure: Generic kcmd push never deletes. After the push, searchEntries still finds Customer revenue (legacy) (status deprecated) and LookupContext will return whatever is in the EntryGroup.
stories.changes: Retirement is a property of the data: every current-mode retrieval on record excluded the legacy metric with reason “superseded; out of force since 2026-06-20”.
stories.status: exclusion real in 13 of 13 retrievals; the ledger delete is RFC text only until sync exists

stories.title: Who may read the policy
stories.who: The finance user asking question 7; the Catalog administrator granting catalogViewer.
stories.failure: The enforcement unit is the EntryGroup and IAM cascades to every entry in it; the policy body is in the overview aspect and in the lookupContext response for anyone with catalogViewer on okf-rfc-demo. Structure, not an observed leak.
stories.changes: RFC text only: one security domain per deployment, caller-delegated BigQuery authorization, policy_context_commitment, mixed-policy fail-closed. Not implemented in Phase A/B.
stories.status: Catalog side real (beat 3); BigQuery side RFC text only
